description: Create a draft purchase invoice from extracted document data and attach the source file. Direct-call contract: pass exact invoice vat_price/gross_price when known, never recalculate; non-EUR requires currency_rate (foreign units per 1 EUR, e.g. USD 1.08); base_* may lock actual EUR settlement.

allow_duplicate_invoice_number.description: Explicit acknowledgement that the supplier reuses this invoice number (e.g. across years): an existing live invoice with the same supplier and number becomes a warning instead of a refusal (default false: refuse).

base_gross_price.description: Actual settled EUR gross total; auto-derived from currency_rate when omitted.

base_net_price.description: EUR equivalent of net_price; auto-derived from currency_rate when omitted.

base_vat_price.description: EUR equivalent of vat_price; auto-derived from currency_rate when omitted.

block_on_duplicate.description: Refuse creation when this receipt's cash outflow looks like an already-booked duplicate (default false: warn only).

currency.description: Currency code (default EUR). Use the original invoice currency (e.g. USD) and supply currency_rate.

currency_rate.description: Exchange rate as foreign currency units per 1 EUR (ECB convention, e.g. USD 1.08; EUR = amount / rate). Required when currency != EUR.

file_name.description: Name for the uploaded document (e.g. the original filename for base64 input); defaults to the source file's name. The file's extension is kept.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source invoice document (PDF/JPG/PNG); uploaded during creation.

gross_price.description: EXACT total gross from the original invoice; never recalculate. Omit only if truly absent from the document.

items.description: Items [{custom_title, cl_purchase_articles_id, purchase_accounts_id, purchase_accounts_dimensions_id?, total_net_price, vat_rate_dropdown?, amount?, vat_accounts_id?, vat_accounts_dimensions_id?, cl_vat_articles_id?, reversed_vat_id?}]. purchase_accounts_dimensions_id is REQUIRED when the expense account has dimensions; same for vat_accounts_dimensions_id on dimensioned VAT accounts. A VAT-registered company's items carrying VAT need vat_rate_dropdown, else refused before create (purchase_totals_mismatch). Non-VAT EUR invoices may post VAT to the same cost account/dimension with article 11 and one document rate.

notes.description: Optional notes (assumptions made, manual adjustments). Do NOT use the source document filename — the document is already uploaded and attached.

require_confirm_plan.description: Read back the actual uploaded draft and issue a single-use confirmation plan; default false for legacy direct calls.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the document returned by extract_pdf_invoice; binds this booking to the exact reviewed bytes.

vat_price.description: EXACT total VAT from the original invoice; never recalculate. Omit only if truly absent from the document.

name: create_purchase_invoice_from_pdf
title: Create Purchase Invoice from PDF
